title: Thotti Jaya
desc: An orphan named Thotti Jaya is hired by a mobster after he is spotted thrashing a dishonest man. However, his troubles begin when he falls in love with his boss' daughter.

title: Manandhal Mahadevan
desc: After returning from the States, Raja receives a marriage proposal from a wealthy family. Accompanied by his driver, Mahadevan, Raja meets the bride, but Mahadevan ends up getting married to her.

title: Mudhal Mariyadhai
desc: A middle-aged upper-caste man, Malaichami, leads an unhappy married life but seeks comfort in a new friendship with a low-caste woman. However, their friendship leads to many rumours in their village.

title: Vasalil Oru Vennila
desc: Ammu, a little girl, runs away from her bungalow as her stepmother physically tortures her. However, the girl finds love and solace in the arms of Kamala, a milk vendor.

title: Thai Maaman
desc: Meena refuses to marry Rasappan as he is uneducated and rustic. In order to win her heart, he decides to become a minister and achieve success.
